title: Advanced农业机械设备展示
reason: The video demonstrates various agricultural machines and their functions in modern farming processes.

tasks.task: Display the functionality of the parsley harvester used for efficient harvesting of herb crops.

subtasks.text: Show the operation of the parsley harvester as it moves through rows of parsley, cutting plants at a predetermined height.
Highlight how the parsley harvester conveys the cut parsley using a vacuum system to a collection area.

tasks.task: Demonstrate the utilization of the Soil-Tiller for soil preparation in agricultural fields.

subtasks.text: Describe the Soil-Tiller's capability to break up stubborn soil clumps.
Explain how the Soil-Tiller creates stable soil mounds for root crop growth.

tasks.task: Showcase the process of peanut harvesting using a machine designed to save labor and time.

subtasks.text: Observe the peanut digger moving through rows, cutting the roots from the underside of plants.
Notice the process of flipping peanut plants over with rotating times, preparing them for harvesting.

tasks.task: Highlight the machine harvesting of grapes and its efficiency in the vineyard.

subtasks.text: Watch the machine harvesting process shaking vines to release grapes onto a conveyor belt.
Notice the removal of impurities from harvested grapes through a series of screens.

tasks.task: Illustrate the use of a tarp system for harvesting various fruits.

subtasks.text: Observe the automatic operation and extension of the tarp system for harvesting fruits like olives and almonds.

tasks.task: Demonstrate the operation and effectiveness of the automatic transplanter for efficient planting.

subtasks.text: Show the preparation of soil and loading of seedling trays into the transplanter.
Notice the precision setting of parameters such as the distance between plants by operators.

tasks.task: Describe the manual harvesting of mangoes using ladders and nets to prevent bruising.

subtasks.text: Watch the process of mango picking by hand, leaving a bit of stem on the fruit.

tasks.task: Showcase the post-harvest handling and processing of mangoes at the packing facility.

subtasks.text: Observe the cooling process of mangoes to remove field heat and extend their shelf life.

tasks.task: Demonstrate the mechanical harvesting process in sugarcane farming.

subtasks.text: Show the mechanical harvester collecting mature sugarcane from September until January.
Notice the efficiency increase in harvesting time from 32 hours to just 6 to 12 hours with mechanical harvesters.
